metadata.title: COURS DE CHYMIE
metadata.title_complement: CONTENANT LA MANIERE DE FAIRE LES OPERATIONS QUI SONT En usage dans la Médecine, par une Méthode facile.

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the characteristic traits of 17th and 18th-century French printing, characterized by moderate contrast between thick and thin strokes, slanted serifs, and a humanist axis. The large display capitals for "COURS DE CHYMIE" exhibit the classic proportions of the Old Style period.
